رُنَآءٌ , with damm, i. q. طَرَبٌ [app. as meaning A lively emotion of joy; mirth, joy, gladness, or delight]. (K. [See also رُنَّاءٌ, in art. رن: and see the last signification of 1 in the present art.]) ―
-b2- Also A sound, voice, or cry: (El-Umawee, T, K:) [like رَنَّةٌ as expl. in the S and K:) pl. أَرْنِيَةٌ. (T.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
